div.head: II Atr 3
div.ab: Et omnis friðmannus, noster pacem habeat in terris et aquis, et intra portum et extra.
⁊ ælc agenra friðmanna frið hæbbe, ge on lande ge on wætere, ge binnan muðan ge butan.
[Be ðæs cyninges fryðmannum.] [Ld] ⁊ ælc agenra friðmanna frið hæbbe, ge on lande ge on wætere, ge binnan muðan ge butan.
But all of those who are specially included in the truce are to enjoy the protection of the truce, whether on land or on water, whether within an estuary or not.
And each of the men to whom the truce applies is to have peace both on land and on water, both within the estuary and outside.

(Von Leuten aus des Königs Friedensgebiet. Ld) Und jeder der Leute, die selbst jenem Frieden[sgebiete dieses Vertrages] angehören, geniesse Friedensschutz, sowohl zu Lande wie zu Wasser, sowohl in der Flussmündung wie draussen.

(Of men from the king's peace-area. Ld) And let every one of the men who themselves belong to that peace[-area of this treaty] enjoy protection, both on land and on water, both within the estuary and outside.
